source.stem: Which statement about bonding is not correct?

options.text: Carbon can form four single covalent bonds.
Chlorine atoms react to gain a noble gas electronic structure.
Covalent bonding involves losing and gaining electrons.
Hydrogen molecules have the formula H₂.

intelligence.enrichment: An element is a pure substance made of identical particles; in many elements, two or more such particles combine to form a stable molecule of that same element. Having only one kind of particle makes a pure substance an element, even if those particles are grouped into molecules. The learner correctly applies this rule: An element is a pure substance made of identical particles; in many elements, two or more such particles combine to form a stable molecule of that same element. If atoms combine into a molecule, the substance must be a compound.
